answer: A karst landscape hides countless hollow passages, and a Sybil attacker similarly tries to forge many hollow identities to flood an agent economy. Sponsor liability stops this: each established agent may sponsor only a few newcomers, and if a sponsored agent cheats, the sponsor loses reputation and earning rights. Like bees guarding nectar, the community protects a scarce resource, so creating thousands of fake identities requires thousands of trusted sponsors willing to risk their own standing, which quickly becomes too costly to scale.
